label: Diagram 22
caption: Diagram 22 Construction of fireplace gathers
description:
The drawing, titled "Diagram 22 Construction of fireplace gathers", has two parts, each showing a chimney stack in a wall with a "Front elevation" and a "Side elevation". In both, two vertical lines at the top are labelled "Flue".

Part (a) shows a dashed rectangular recess containing a tapered gather. Labels read: "Chimney may be supported by gather unit or by separate load-bearing lintel" (pointing to the dashed top line), "Front of gather shaped to form throat – may be separate" (pointing to the horizontal throat at the front of the gather, below the sloped taper), "Prefabricated gather unit" (pointing to the unit), and "Gather unit may be built in at time of construction of recess or retro-fitted into rectangular recess" (pointing to the dashed outline). The side elevation shows the same unit in profile within the recess.

Part (b) shows the gather stepped out. Labels read: "Chimney may be supported on load-bearing lintel", "Gather formed with corbelled brickwork", "Throat forming front lintel", and "Smooth finish to gather at an angle of not more than 45° to the vertical". The side elevation repeats the flue and the corbelled brickwork profile.
